data.feature_id_column: Feature/gene id column in --input expression matrix (default: first column).
data.cell_id_column: Cell id column in --annot metadata (default: first column).
data.samples_include: Only keep cells from these samples.
data.clusters_include: Only keep cells in these clusters.
data.features_include: Only keep these feature/gene rows in the clustering matrix.
data.features_exclude: Drop these feature/gene rows from the clustering matrix.

plot_mode.distance_method: dist() method: euclidean, maximum, manhattan, canberra, binary, minkowski, or correlation/spearman.
plot_mode.cluster_method: hclust method: average, ward.D, ward.D2, single, complete, mcquitty, median, centroid.

labels.title: Plot title (default 'Dendrogram for clusters in samples').

colors.group_colors: Named vector of colors keyed by sample (Sample_Group) for the color bar and tip points.
colors.x_text_colors: Named vector of colors keyed by label group when x_text_color_by is set.
colors.x_text_color_by: none, sample, or cluster. Colors x-axis labels by sample or cluster group.
colors.x_text_legend_title: Override the x-text color legend title.

layers.tile_height_ratio: Height ratio of the group color bar relative to the tree (default 0.05).
layers.point_size: Tip point size at the bottom of the tree.

legends.legend_position: right, left, bottom, top, or none.
legends.legend_title: Override the group color legend title (default = sample_column).
legends.show_x_text_legend: Show/hide the x-text color legend when x_text_color_by is set.
